Andrew Buller - Sport Massage Therapist based in Barnstaple, North Devon. Andrew has been practicing since 2007 and specialises in injury rehabilitation for sport/non sport related injuries. The video clips are to develop the bodies natural resources improving ones biomechanics and movement patterns, to aid recovery from an injury back to performance or use for injury prevention.

Before performing any exercise please seek advice from an healthcare/medical professional, Each injury is unique to its form of occurrence and road back to performance.
